code:
F(x) = q * x^T*Sigma*x  -  r^T*x  +  P*(sum(x_i) - B)^2

q       = risk aversion
Sigma   = covariance matrix (risk between assets)
r       = expected returns
P*(...)  = budget penalty, exactly Lesson 2's pattern
caption: Risk term contributes the quadratic coefficients; return term contributes the linear ones -- both baked into one Q matrix.
Select assets 1 and 2 -- the two highest returns, and the penalty swamps every budget-violating choice exactly as designed.
